natural.elevation.description: Vertical position of the terrain, from the deepest depressions to the highest summits; water coverage is determined separately.
natural.elevation.low: Profoundly sunken terrain: deep basins, hollowed depressions and the lowest reaches of the world.
natural.elevation.high: Soaring summits and monumental ridgelines tower above the surrounding world.

natural.ocean.description: Presence of the ocean within its configured footprint and sea-level constraint.
natural.ocean.low: No ocean occupies this ground; other water features may still be present.
natural.ocean.high: The ocean claims this place: an immense body of salt water with no walkable ground in this cell.

biome.river.description: Strength within the river channel; crossing permission comes from the separate river barrier field.
biome.river.low: No river channel at zero; near zero, the faintest thread or fringe of running water.
biome.river.high: The full heart of a great river dominates the terrain, its channel commanding the scene.

biome.void.description: A void replaces the ground. Interpret as a physical abyss or, where the setting supports it, the Void beyond ordinary reality.
biome.void.low: No void breaks the ground here.
biome.void.high: An abyss interrupts the world; in a fantastic setting this may be the Void itself, an absence beyond ordinary space.

biome.groundcover.description: Abundance of basic low vegetation: grasses, herbs, ferns, low shrubs and other plants appropriate to the compiled biome.
biome.groundcover.low: Almost naked ground, with scarcely a blade, tuft or creeping shoot.
biome.groundcover.high: Thick, vigorous ground vegetation characteristic of this biome: lush grass, abundant herbs or dense low shrubs as the setting warrants.

biome.large_foliage.description: Abundance of trees and other large plants; species and form follow the surrounding setting.
biome.large_foliage.low: An utterly open skyline: no trees or towering foliage, hardly a stem rising above the low growth.
biome.large_foliage.high: Towering growth crowds overhead in immense, overlapping masses, enclosing the scene beneath a canopy.

biome.moisture.description: Ambient moisture and humidity, independent of water-feature presence and weather severity.
biome.moisture.low: Desiccating dryness: powdery surfaces, brittle textures and air that seems to draw moisture from everything.
biome.moisture.high: Saturated, clinging damp: beads of condensation, sodden textures and air heavy with moisture.

biome.weather_severity.description: Force and disruption of local weather, with its form supplied by the setting.
biome.weather_severity.low: Almost preternatural stillness: soft air and scarcely a stirring or disturbance.
biome.weather_severity.high: Weather at its most overwhelming: battering force, engulfing conditions and a landscape consumed by the elements.

biome.exposed_rock.description: Amount of visible stone and bedrock, independent of elevation and vegetation.
biome.exposed_rock.low: Stone is almost entirely hidden beneath the surface cover.
biome.exposed_rock.high: The bones of the earth stand naked: immense slabs, fractured outcrops and raw stone dominate every view.

biome.lakes_ponds.description: Presence and interior strength of a lake or pond; positive water coverage follows the configured traversal rule.
biome.lakes_ponds.low: No lake at zero; near zero, the slenderest water margin or shallow pond edge.
biome.lakes_ponds.high: Open inland water fills the scene, gathering into the full body of a lake or pond.

biome.chasms.description: Presence of a deep open fissure that blocks exploration.
biome.chasms.low: No open chasm splits this ground.
biome.chasms.high: A yawning rupture cleaves the earth, with sheer broken walls dropping into an unseen depth.

biome.river_barrier.description: Authoritative river crossing constraint, independent of how dramatic the river is described.
biome.river_barrier.low: River water does not block this cell; where a river exists, this is crossing relief. Other biome blockers still apply.
biome.river_barrier.high: The river presents an uncrossable barrier at this cell; no narrative ford or bridge overrides that constraint.

civilization.density.description: Current population density: actual living inhabitants, human or non-human, independent of infrastructure, wealth, age and advancement.
civilization.density.low: At zero, no current residents. Near zero, occasional or widely scattered inhabitants go about daily life.
civilization.density.high: Intensely populated: throngs of residents fill a bustling city, sprawling community or equally crowded setting appropriate to infrastructure.

civilization.age.description: How far into the past civilization impact reaches, independent of present population, sophistication or ruin condition.
civilization.age.low: The first fresh marks of civilization: an arrival so recent that almost nothing has acquired a history.
civilization.age.high: Civilization reaches back through lost ages: successive eras lie layered beneath memory, their beginnings swallowed by antiquity.

civilization.advancement.description: Technical sophistication and capability, independent of wealth, population and infrastructure amount.
civilization.advancement.low: The bare beginnings of technique: elementary tools, direct handwork and severely limited technical means.
civilization.advancement.high: Staggering technical mastery: exquisitely developed methods and capabilities at the farthest limits allowed by this world.

civilization.aggression.description: Disposition toward confrontation and coercion, independent of species, wealth and affiliation.
civilization.aggression.low: Radical gentleness and forbearance: accommodation, restraint and an almost unshakable refusal of confrontation.
civilization.aggression.high: Ruthless belligerence: threats, domination and coercion saturate social dealings, with conflict always close to the surface.

civilization.commerce.description: Intensity of exchange, independent of material wealth and technical advancement.
civilization.commerce.low: Exchange has dwindled to nothing: no markets, no trading bustle, scarcely anything changing hands.
civilization.commerce.high: A fever of commerce: bargaining, deliveries and ceaseless exchange turn every gathering into a marketplace.

civilization.wealth.description: Material resources and reserves; express scarcity or abundance in forms appropriate to the local inhabitants.
civilization.wealth.low: Grinding destitution: exhausted stores, threadbare possessions and scraps hoarded against desperate need; hunger or squalor where the context supports it.
civilization.wealth.high: Dazzling opulence: overflowing reserves, lavish possessions and astonishing material abundance far beyond ordinary need.

civilization.species_homogeneity.description: How mixed the inhabited population is; this carries no inherent moral, political or behavioral meaning.
civilization.species_homogeneity.low: An extraordinary intermingling of peoples or species, with no single population dominating the community.
civilization.species_homogeneity.high: An almost complete monoculture: one people or species fills the community, with scarcely an outsider represented.

civilization.infrastructure.description: Extent of constructed fabric, independent of current occupation, technical level, age and upkeep.
civilization.infrastructure.low: Almost no built fabric: bare terrain, a faint track or the most minimal shelter.
civilization.infrastructure.high: Construction overwhelms the landscape: sprawling structures, layered routes and extensive engineered systems occupy nearly every available space.

civilization.footprint.description: Strength of present or past civilization impact; this is the shared presence footprint, not proof of current inhabitants.
civilization.footprint.low: No civilization footprint at zero; near zero, only the faintest isolated trace of habitation or construction.
civilization.footprint.high: Civilization has thoroughly marked the terrain: a powerful built or inhabited imprint, whether bustling or abandoned.

civilization.animal_population.description: Concentration of land animals, independent of organized civilization and animal species mix.
civilization.animal_population.low: Animal life is absent or hauntingly sparse: scarcely a movement, call or fresh track.
civilization.animal_population.high: Animal life throngs the place: dense gatherings and constant movement fill the scene with living bodies.

civilization.animal_homogeneity.description: Animal species concentration, independent of animal abundance and aggression.
civilization.animal_homogeneity.low: A profusion of different animal kinds shares the habitat, with no single species prevailing.
civilization.animal_homogeneity.high: Almost every animal belongs to the same species: wolves upon wolves, or the local equivalent, with scarcely another kind.

variation.whimsy.description: Playful imaginative tone; independent of danger, absurdity and literal supernatural power.
variation.whimsy.low: Severely sober and orthodox: practical forms, earnest customs and not a trace of playful fancy.
variation.whimsy.high: Exuberantly fanciful: joyous oddities, delightful flourishes and a sense of wonder spill into every fitting detail.

variation.chaos.description: Instability and disorder within established facts; never permission to contradict app state.
variation.chaos.low: Clockwork order: patterns hold, arrangements remain exact and every detail seems firmly in its place.
variation.chaos.high: Tumultuous disorder: arrangements unravel, competing forces collide and the scene feels perpetually on the verge of upheaval.

variation.fantasticness.description: Distance from mundane possibilities, bounded by established world facts and app mechanics.
variation.fantasticness.low: Resolutely mundane: ordinary materials and natural explanations, without a hint of the marvelous.
variation.fantasticness.high: Astonishingly otherworldly: wonders beyond ordinary experience saturate the setting, as extraordinary as established world rules permit.

variation.unexpectedness.description: Surprise relative to this particular setting and its established expectations.
variation.unexpectedness.low: Utterly familiar and foreseeable: each detail follows naturally from what came before.
variation.unexpectedness.high: A succession of breathtaking reversals of expectation: startling discoveries that remain coherent with established facts.

variation.interestingness.description: Density of details that invite attention; low values mean restraint, not poor narration.
variation.interestingness.low: Quietly uneventful and unassuming: simple textures, few focal points and room to breathe.
variation.interestingness.high: Intensely arresting: striking details and tantalizing implications compete for attention at every turn.

variation.absurdity.description: Incongruity and surreal juxtaposition; independent of whimsy, danger and app-state correctness.
variation.absurdity.low: Uncompromisingly sensible: conventional relationships and nothing out of place.
variation.absurdity.high: Gloriously outrageous incongruity: surreal juxtapositions and straight-faced impossibilities of custom strain all ordinary expectations.

variation.opportunity.description: Narrative abundance of promising openings; actual awards and availability remain app-authoritative.
variation.opportunity.low: An unforgiving lack of openings: little advantage, little promise and scarcely a prospect to seize.
variation.opportunity.high: Possibility seems to overflow: extraordinary openings and enticing prospects crowd the scene wherever mechanics support them.

variation.danger.description: Atmosphere and intensity of threat; does not itself create death, damage or traversal rules.
variation.danger.low: Profoundly sheltered and unthreatening in tone, with scarcely a sign of menace; explicit hazards still remain authoritative.
variation.danger.high: Overwhelming menace: exposure and peril press in from every side, making every permitted choice feel consequential.

occurrences.certain_death.description: A Certain Death occurrence whose activation and consequences must be resolved by the app, never invented by narration.
occurrences.certain_death.low: No Certain Death occurrence is assigned here; this does not promise safety.
occurrences.certain_death.high: An absolute terminal peril is assigned here: portray its finality vividly, but announce death only if the app resolves it.

occurrences.teleport.description: A relocation occurrence; the app determines activation and destination.
occurrences.teleport.low: No teleport occurrence is assigned here.
occurrences.teleport.high: A dramatic passage to elsewhere is present: render the transition with the full character of this setting, using only the app-assigned destination and outcome.

occurrences.gift.description: An award occurrence supporting status, inventory and/or badges. A co-located challenge resolves first; grant only when its requirement is satisfied.
occurrences.gift.low: No gift occurrence is assigned here; this does not erase ordinary possessions or narrative generosity.
occurrences.gift.high: A pointed moment of bestowal: make the authorized award feel distinctive and memorable, without increasing its assigned quantity, power or eligibility.

occurrences.challenge.description: Exactly two outcomes: requirement present or absent. The app checks registered item, status or affiliation IDs before any co-located gift; AI chooses narrative valence independently.
occurrences.challenge.low: No challenge occurrence is assigned here; ordinary narrative difficulties may still exist.
occurrences.challenge.high: A decisive test confronts the traveler: make both the requirement-present and requirement-absent outcomes vivid and consequential, while preserving the app-selected branch and award eligibility.

civilization.faction.description: Abstract faction identity. Give its local manifestation a vivid name, symbols, customs and history shaped by the other fields. The enum slot has no inherent rank, morality, intensity or fixed narrative identity.

civilization.kingdom.description: Abstract kingdom identity. Give its local manifestation a vivid name, symbols, customs and history shaped by the other fields. The enum slot has no inherent rank, morality, intensity or fixed narrative identity.

civilization.religion.description: Abstract religion identity. Give its local manifestation a vivid name, symbols, customs and history shaped by the other fields. The enum slot has no inherent rank, morality, intensity or fixed narrative identity.
